description: This file contains a class `lakeraAI_Moderation` which integrates Lakera AI's moderation capabilities into a broader system. It defines methods to check responses for flagged content, perform moderation via HTTP requests, and hooks for pre-call and moderation events within a FastAPI-based environment. The class extends `CustomGuardrail` and utilizes various helper functions and data structures for guardrail operation.
